findings.title: settle returns before the last seat exits
findings.detail: settle() polls only seats that were running at its first pass; a seat started on resume is never awaited.

findings.title: judge stdin left open
findings.detail: The judge job may hang if stdin is not closed.

findings.title: secret file list includes a world-readable path
findings.detail: default_secret_files lists a path that may be world-readable.

findings.title: resumed seat not awaited
findings.detail: A seat relaunched on resume is missing from the wait set.

reviewer_findings.message: panel.settle can return while a resumed seat is still running (workflow/panel.py:212).
No unit test covers the judge-fallback banner.

rulings.title: settle does not wait for a seat relaunched on resume
rulings.detail: The wait set is built once from the seats running at the first pass; a seat relaunched on resume is never awaited, so the judge can start without its findings.
rulings.requirement: PRD 7.2: the judge starts only after every seat has finished, failed or timed out
rulings.reason: Reproduced by reading settle(): seats added by _relaunch are not in `waiting`.

rulings.title: No unit test for the judge-fallback banner
rulings.detail: The banner renders (scenario covered in the browser suite) but no unit test pins its text.
rulings.reason: A test gap, not a defect in behaviour: regraded from P1 to P2.

rulings.title: judge stdin left open
rulings.detail: The job is started with stdin=DEVNULL.

rulings.title: secret file list includes a world-readable path
rulings.detail: Pre-existing: the cited code is unchanged since the run's base.
rulings.reason: Unchanged since the run's base and named by no PRD or decisions line (base-scope rule).
